Game Overview

In Telekinesis Attack, the core idea is straightforward: harness the power of your mind in Telekinesis Attack, manipulating the environment to outsmart your enemies. Engage in physics-based strategy as you disarm, hurl, and defeat diverse foes. Master the art of timing and aiming, turning any object into a lethal weapon on your path to victory.
